2014 BRZ | Trim Levels
“… the 2013 Subaru BRZ is a welcome return to an era
of fun, light, simple sports cars that are affordable, too.”
— Cars.com, October 2012
“Subaru has racked up more endorsements by
independent arbiters of automotive quality and safety
than just about any other manufacturer.”1
— FORTUNE Magazine, December 3, 2012
BRZ Premium
• 200-hp direct-injected 2.0-liter 4-cylinder SUBARU BOXER® engine
• Close-ratio 6-speed manual transmission
“This is a genuine sports car, a breed that has
• Sport-tuned suspension
nearly gone extinct.”2
• Multi-spoke 17-inch aluminum-alloy wheels
— LeftLaneNews.com, December 2012
• HID headlights
• Cloth upholstery
• 8-speaker audio system with integrated touch-screen navigation system
• Manually adjustable air-conditioning system
13
BRZ Limited
• 200-hp direct-injected 2.0-liter 4-cylinder SUBARU BOXER® engine s Fog lights
• Close-ratio 6-speed manual transmission s Trunk spoiler
• Sport-tuned suspension s Alcantara® and leather-trimmed upholstery
• Multi-spoke 17-inch aluminum-alloy wheels s Heated front seats and side mirrors
• HID headlights s Dual-zone digital climate control
• 8-speaker audio system with integrated touch-screen s Keyless Access & Start
navigation system s Antitheft security system

2 Accolade based on 2013 Subaru BRZ.

| 2014
BRZ
2014 BRZ | Specifications 2014 BRZ | Specifications
Engine and Drivetrain BRZ Chassis BRZ
Power | Torque 2.0-liter DOHC aluminum-alloy 16-valve 4-cylinder horizontally opposed SUBARU BOXER® engine Steering Electric power-assisted quick ratio rack-and-pinion. Ratio: 13.1:1. Turns lock-to-lock: 2.48.
with Dual Active Valve Control System (DAVCS). Turning circle: 35.4 feet.
200 hp @ 7,000 rpm | 151 lb-ft @ 6,400 rpm
Suspension Sport-tuned 4-wheel independent.
Compression Ratio 12.5:1 Front: Strut-type with lower L-arm. Stabilizer bar.
Rear: Double wishbone. Stabilizer bar.
Bore and Stroke 86.0 x 86.0 mm
Brakes 4-wheel disc, ventilated front and rear. Dual-piston front and single-piston rear calipers. 4-channel,
4-sensor ABS with Electronic Brake-force Distribution (EBD)
Fuel System Direct and port fuel injection
Brake Discs (front/rear) 11.6 inches/11.4 inches
Manual Transmission Close-ratio 6-speed manual
Brake Assist When emergency braking is detected by how quickly the brake pedal is pressed, maximum brake
Automatic Transmission 6-speed electronic automatic transmission with Sport mode, and manual mode with paddle shifters with pressure is immediately applied.
rev-matching downshift control.
BRZ Premium: Not Available. BRZ Limited: Optional. Brake Override System If both brake and accelerator pedals are pressed simultaneously, the system reduces the operation of the
accelerator pedal to help prevent unintentional vehicle acceleration.
Traction and Stability
Wheels and Tires
Drivetrain Rear-wheel drive
Wheels Premium and Limited: 17 x 7.0-inch multi-spoke aluminum-alloy. Dark gray with machine finish.
Rear Differential Torsen® limited slip
Tires 215/45 R17 87W summer-performance
Vehicle Stability Control Includes Sport mode 15
(VSC)
Traction Control System
(TCS)
Fuel
Fuel Economy city/highway/combined1 Manual: 22/30/25 mpg
Automatic: 25/34/28 mpg
Fuel Requirement Premium unleaded gasoline
(93 octane)
Fuel Capacity 13.2 gallons
Standard Optional Not equipped

Drive it for a day. Love it for life.
Life moves fast. Don’t slow it down with a car you can’t trust. At Subaru, we build each of our vehicles with
the highest standards of manufacturing, and with designs that are inherently tough and resilient. It’s why our
vehicles excel in the most rigorous of motorsports, like rally racing. And why 96% of all the vehicles we’ve
built in the last 12 years are still on the road today.1 It’s also why Subaru owners are so likely to stay Subaru
owners for years and years. What’s more, keeping cars on the road means they stay out of landfills longer.
And if we can make the world a cleaner and greener place while making cars that inspire and motivate their
drivers, we’ve done our job.
Find out more about our efforts to
keep it cleaner and greener.
